subject: Quick follow-up from InferenceConf — discovery & next steps
messages:

Subject: Quick follow-up from InferenceConf — discovery & next steps

Hi Anika — great meeting you at InferenceConf yesterday. Really enjoyed our conversation about how Luminex is trying to move more inference to dedicated GPU pools for low-latency multimodal features.

Per our chat, I wanted to: 1) recap suggested agenda for a short discovery call, and 2) share a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align stakeholders.

Proposed 30-min discovery agenda:
- Current inference patterns (models, latencies, qps)
- Cost/ROI goals & constraints (on-prem vs cloud tradeoffs)
- Security/compliance must-haves (SOC2, data residency)
- Quick path to pilot (timeline + success metrics)

I've attached a short product deck and a MAP template I use with similar customers. If you have 20–30 minutes next week, here's my calendar link: https://cal.com/sergio/redwood-discuss. Otherwise share a few times that work.

Attachments: Redwood-Intro-Deck.pdf, MAP-Luminex-v1.xlsx

Best,
Sergio Alvarez

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika@luminex.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-26T14:36:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap & MAP (next steps)

Anika / Michael — thanks again for the call. Recap below and proposed next steps. Forwarding the MAP with action owners attached.

Call highlights:
- Luminex current: 3 multimodal models in prod, peak 200 qps for image text features, p95 latency ~560ms on current infra.
- Target: p95 <= 220ms, reduce per-inference cost by 25–40% on expected Black Friday traffic pattern.
- Constraints: SOC2 required for customer pilots; some datasets must remain in us-west region.

Proposed pilot plan (4–6 weeks):
1) Week 0: Baseline metrics + sample traffic ingestion (you provide 24h trace)
2) Week 1–2: Pilot on Redwood Dedicated (2x A100 equiv) + prefix cache config
3) Week 3: Run load test + measure p95/cost; iterate quantization settings
4) Week 4: Recommendation + canary rollout plan to your cluster

MAP (attached): owners and dates — please review and update.

Open asks from us:
- Can you send a 24-hour sample trace and rough model sizes?
- SOC2 timeline (expected completion quarter)?
- Primary pilot owner & Slack channel to add Redwood SREs?

Attachments: MAP-Luminex-v1.xlsx

Next step: We'll follow up with a short SOW-ish pilot estimate once we get the trace — target to share by 12/03.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Would you prefer a brief sync or should we park until Jan?

Sergio
